answer.reason: The verses tell of Andrew following Jesus and bringing his brother, and of his leaving his nets at Jesus' call.

clauses.english: left his nets and followed Jesus when called from fishing
clauses.quote: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.

clauses.english: brought his brother Simon to Jesus, saying they had found the Messias
clauses.quote: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias

doubts: MAT 4:20 gives the leaving of nets for both brothers; the clause is kept to Andrew as one of them.
Verses naming Andrew only in apostle lists (MAT 10:2, MRK 3:18, LUK 6:14, ACT 1:13) were not used, since the summary already covers them.
JHN 6:8 and JHN 12:22 show Andrew speaking, but were left out as minor.
